2609.28430.title: Cross-Scale Transfer Learning for Depression Severity Prediction: From PHQ-8 to HAMD-17 Across Languages and Clinical Paradigms
2609.28430.paper_summary: This work addresses continuous depression-severity score prediction from clinical interview transcripts under data scarcity. We propose a sequential low-rank adaptation (LoRA) protocol for cross-scale transfer: a Qwen3 backbone with a bounded regression head is first fine-tuned on the English DAIC-WOZ dataset (189 avatar-mediated sessions, PHQ-8), and the adapter then initializes fine-tuning on the Chinese PDCH dataset (100 real clinical consultations, HAMD-17), where a reinitialised, scale-specific head predicts the clinician-assigned score. All configurations use patient-level stratified 5-fold, 2-repeat cross-validation. On the data-scarce HAMD-17 target, the sequential protocol attains the best point-estimate MAE , RMSE, and macro-$F_1$ on both 0.6B and 1.7B backbones, outperforming target-only training and non-LLM baselines---4.96/6.59/0.36 with Qwen3-0.6B and 4.38/5.62/0.46 with Qwen3-1.7B. Ablations suggest that correctly aligned source supervision gives the best point estimates (unsupervised exposure and shuffled-label controls also show partial gains), that native-Chinese target input outperforms machine-translated English input, and that the reversed order yields no clear gain within run-to-run variance. The study is an exploratory, single-site internal evaluation: it does not establish screening or diagnostic utility, nor separately identify the contribution of the scale, language, or paradigm shifts. To our knowledge, no prior study evaluates this specific DAIC-WOZ-to-PDCH sequential transfer setting.
2609.28430.paper_summary_zh: 這項工作針對在數據稀缺情況下從臨床訪談轉錄中預測持續的抑鬱嚴重程度分數。<lb/>我們提出了一種連續低秩適應（LoRA）協議，用於跨尺度轉移：首先在英語DAIC-WOZ數據集（189次虛擬角色介導的會話，PHQ-8）上對Qwen3主幹進行微調，然後適配器在中文PDCH數據集（100次真實臨床諮詢，HAMD-17）上初始化微調，其中重新初始化的特定於尺度的頭部預測臨床醫生分配的分數。<lb/>所有配置均使用患者級別的分層5折、2次重複交叉驗證。<lb/>在數據稀缺的HAMD-17目標上，連續協議在0.6B和1.7B主幹上均達到最佳點估計MAE、RMSE和宏觀$F_1$，超越了僅針對目標的訓練和非LLM基準——Qwen3-0.6B的結果為4.96/6.59/0.36，Qwen3-1.7B的結果為4.38/5.62/0.46。<lb/>消融實驗表明，正確對齊的源監督提供了最佳的點估計（無監督暴露和隨機標籤控制也顯示出部分增益），本地中文目標輸入優於機器翻譯的英語輸入，且反向順序在運行間變異中未顯示出明顯增益。<lb/>該研究是一項探索性的單點內部評估：它並未確立篩查或診斷效用，也未單獨識別尺度、語言或範式轉變的貢獻。<lb/>據我們所知，之前沒有研究評估這一特定的DAIC-WOZ到PDCH的連續轉移設置。
